title.p: Chapter 1775: War of living and dead (3)

section.p: Amid the boundless void.
Heavenly Overseer Marquis frowned. He had an endless desire to curse at someone.
Fuck!

He hadn’t even done anything! The scheme had merely been exposed. Was Su Yu the only one allowed to scheme? He was only trying to complete his Heavenly Hunt Index. Why did Su Yu start a fight over something like this?
Just what was that madman trying to do?
And thus, the sullen Heavenly Overseer Marquis fled into the boundless void with his Heavenly Hunt Pavilion.
Madman!
Great Zhou King was crazy as well. Why was he obeying such an unreasonable order?

That was not all. Great Zhou King had even used all his strength to teleport over, ignoring the damage it would cause to his body. Together with the record character, Great Zhou King was rapidly approaching the pavilion.
Moments later, Great Zhou King was near enough to sense Heavenly Overseer Marquis’ presence.
A dao erupted in power as he attacked with all his strength.
Heavenly Overseer Marquis roared, “Su Yu! Must you push me now? You can’t kill me! Tiangu and the others won’t allow this to happen! Are you really trying to start another war?”
Damn that lunatic!
What an annoying person to deal with!
Meanwhile, Su Yu had long vanished.
He was too busy to entertain Heavenly Overseer Marquis.
The two could have a good fight. The fight had better be intense, creating violent fluctuations that would attract everyone’s attention.
The Myriad Realms were too calm. Some chaos was needed.

At the moment, several daos were colliding violently around the old turtle, signifying that Great Qin King and Great Xia King had finally joined the battle. The fluctuations were contained, but not fully. Thus, others might still be able to detect what was happening.
The attacker was trying to assassinate the old turtle in secret. But Su Yu also wanted to kill the assassin in secret.
After rushing back to the Human Realm, Su Yu continued moving rapidly. Inside the Human Realm, his movement was even faster. In the blink of an eye, he was back at Culture King’s Residence.

The white dog was still watering his plants while the book spirit was still reading to the others. Su Yu hurriedly shouted, “Help! Senior Book Spirit and Senior Tea Plant, I require help! Senior Fat Ball, please help!”
Fat Ball asked with surprise, “Who we beating?”
“West Heavenly King!”
Yes. West Heavenly King. Su Yu intended to send the three of them to the Death Realm. He did not plan to let them battle in the world of the living.

First, they had to remove the threat in the Death Realm. How did he conclude that West Heavenly King was related to this disturbance? Because according to what he knew, North Heavenly King vastly preferred keeping a low profile. He was opposed to human rule, but he rarely concerned himself with the affairs in the Spirit Suppression Domain.
Furthermore, there were some human marquises under his command. Meanwhile, there wasn’t a single human marquis under West Heavenly King’s command.
The white dog hesitated. After a short moment, he said, “Fine. But I need to come back quickly. I can’t be away for more than three days…”
“No problem.”
Then, the three gathered. After reaching out to grab them, Su Yu vanished with them.
The little furball wanted to go with them as well, but he was stopped by the big tree in the courtyard. The big tree said blankly, “Don’t go…study…Book Spirit told us to study…”
The tree was speaking, but it also seemed like it had no idea what it was doing. It only knew that they must study, greatly infuriating the little furball.
Why? Why couldn’t he leave?
This was infuriating!
He was certain he was much smarter than this big guy!
As for Su Yu, he couldn’t spare any attention to them. He was in a hurry. Furthermore, the big tree still lacked wisdom. It was unlikely that it would be able to truly harm the little furball.
Su Yu exited the Human Realm promptly, but he did not head straight to the Sea of Stars.

Rather, he circled the area before vanishing. He was trying to determine the coordinates of his human lord’s token. He planned to create a death tunnel straight to the location of the battle before stuffing the three experts through it. He was determined to kill West Heavenly King.

He saw no reason to hold back. After all, those in the world of the living would remain oblivious to West Heavenly King’s death. Since they dared to provoke him, they should be prepared to face death.
It would be unwise to allow the battle in the world of the living to grow too intense. That could easily attract the participation of other Daofuses. Su Yu was not ready to start another war so soon.

Before long, he found a secluded location and opened a death tunnel there. He did not bother to check the situation on the other side. Regardless of how dangerous things were, the three experts should be powerful enough to emerge victorious. He only needed to focus on sending them through.
“Senior Fat Ball, make sure to kill that fellow after entering. He is very strong.”
“Yeah, yeah. Don’t forget, take me back home in three days. If I lose Master’s home, I’ll bite you.”
Su Yu etched the matter into his mind. He was certain Fat Ball would bite him to death if that were to happen.

After shutting the tunnel, Su Yu departed. He exhaled in relief. With the three experts there, coupled with Heavendoom, Grandstar, Empyrean Cloud, Tian Yue, and Marquis Lanshan, they should be able to prevail against West Heavenly King.

He was only worried that North Heavenly King would join the fight while South Heavenly King remained silent. Or even worse, South Heavenly King had decided to act against them as well. That would certainly be disastrous.

But up until now, his human lord’s token was still in active battle, signifying that the battle was still ongoing. If all three heavenly kings were attacking, it was unlikely that his people down there would be able to last this long.

Instead of doing the logical thing and sending everyone to help the old turtle, he had decided to resolve the threat in the Death Realm first. Smooth communication between the living and the dead was very difficult, even for Su Yu.

If they could resolve the crisis in the Death Realm, the enemy in the world of the living would be hard-pressed to do anything against them. Perhaps even escaping would no longer be possible for these enemies.
“The iron devourers can’t act as that will provoke the interference of Tiangu and the others.”
Su Yu sank into thought. Those allied races could not act as that would widen the scale of the battle and cause further troubles.

The sole Daofuse of humanity, Great Zhou King, was busy picking a fight with Heavenly Overseer Marquis. That was something the various races could tolerate. But the participation of September and the others would most certainly draw their interference.
“Who else can I find to join a battle between Daofuses?”

September himself was unsuitable as well since he wasn’t even a Daofuse yet. Otherwise, it wouldn’t be a bad idea for him to set off alone. Tiangu and the others wouldn’t mind the movement of a singular expert.
Heavenbridge Marquis couldn’t leave the mansion.
Su Yu couldn’t think of anyone suitable.
“I’m only worried that the attacker will flee after West Heavenly King’s defeat.”
The mysterious attacker wouldn’t be foolish enough to stay after West Heavenly King’s death.
“Sealing the old turtle’s dao to prevent his escape…In that case, let me seal you as well.”
Su Yu decided to handle it himself. He had numerous trump cards he could choose from. Firstly, he had the Token of Sanctification. However, he wasn’t too keen on using it since it had limited usage.

Secondly, the padlocks from the four rooms in Culture King’s Residence. He had collected two of the padlocks. With the padlocks, he could erect a seal around Grand Dream City. Thirdly, he could join the battle with the remaining Daofuse blood essence in his possession. However, his supply of Daofuse blood essence was running low.
The two furballs were currently roaming the Allheaven Battlefield. He did not intend to have them join the battle unless absolutely necessary.

While thinking about all that, Su Yu was traveling toward Grand Dream City. He would handle this personally. He could sense just how powerful the dao of the attacker was. The old turtle was fully on the defensive. This wasn’t sustainable. His defenses would be breached sooner or later. He might survive it, but things could still get troublesome.
Also, the old turtle seemed to be quite bad at a battle between daos.
The experts of the various realms were observing the battle.

Not the battle involving the old turtle. Rather, they were observing the battle between Great Zhou King and Heavenly Overseer Marquis in the boundless void. At the moment, Great Zhou King was using all his strength.
He had caught up to Heavenly Overseer Marquis, and the resulting battle filled the sky with countless explosions. Meanwhile, Heavenly Overseer Marquis was feeling incredibly vexed. Was he so unlucky?
Why was this bastard attacking for real?
He roared, “Zhou Tianqi, have you gone mad! Why do you insist on fighting me?”
This guy must have gone mad!

The experts of the hou, iron devourer, and spatial beast races were also observing the battle from their realms. From their reaction, it was clear this wasn’t a premeditated battle. Rather, it had erupted out of nowhere.
These allies of humanity wouldn’t be so dumbfounded otherwise. In fact, they were quite confused. They were unsure if they should join this sudden battle. The various races noted their reaction.
And they were left speechless.
So this was a completely random battle!

These allies of humanity were completely clueless about it. Not even the book spirit and tea plant, who had participated in the previous battle, could be seen. It was likely that even the human race itself had not expected this.
“What’s going on?”

The Fate Pseudo Emperor was also greatly confused. Attacking Heavenly Overseer Marquis for such a minor matter? Why was he finding it so hard to believe? Also, Great Zhou King wasn’t even capable of killing Heavenly Overseer Marquis. What was the point of this battle?
“Is he doing this purely out of anger? Is Su Yu’s temper really so bad?”

Numerous possibilities emerged in Fate Pseudo Emperor’s mind. He frowned. The events of the Myriad Realms were getting more and more confusing. He wanted to say that Su Yu was reliable, but that was too unconvincing since Su Yu seemed too easily provoked.
But he also couldn’t say that Su Yu was unreliable since his rate of success in whatever he did was surprisingly high.
“Just what’s going on here?”
He did not dare to leave his realm as that could easily result in a misunderstanding. But it would also be far harder for him to see more things without leaving his realm. He felt helpless.
Things were too confusing.
Things were confusing in the world of the living.
But things were much more straightforward in the world of the dead.
Not long after the battle started, the sky split open and spat out three powerful beings with boundless life force.
They had arrived near the battleground.

With one look, the white dog noticed the powerful heavenly king. He roared anxiously, “Kill him! Quickly! Finish the job and go back home! I just recalled that I wasn’t done watering all the flowers today!”
The white dog grew agitated.
Shit! Shit! Shit!

Previously, he only remembered that he needed to return in three days. But he had completely forgotten that he was still in the middle of watering the flowers. Half the flowers were still waiting to be watered.
Both the book spirit and tea plant grew anxious as well. “You weren’t done watering the flowers today?”
“I forgot since we were leaving in a hurry…”
“Damn it! The flowers will die!”
The three grew increasingly anxious. They had to finish this battle quickly!
“Woof! Woof! Woof!”
The white dog started barking anxiously. He couldn’t drag this out for long. He had to return and water the flowers. That was his second most important duty after the duty of guarding the house.

Marquis Lanshan and the others were overjoyed to see them, while West Heavenly King’s expression changed. Instantly, a dog manifested in the sky. At the same time, the white dog charged forward in his own body as well.
“I’ll bite you to death! Die faster! If you don’t die faster, my flowers will die!”
The white dog was in a hurry.
Die! Faster!
“Nom!”
He wasn’t even barking anymore. He focused on biting. He must bite this annoying king to death. The flowers he had spent over a hundred thousand years caring for were about to die!
Great daos clashed.

The white dog was much stronger than Su Yu. With one bite, even the dao of death spirit trembled violently. As for West Heavenly King’s personal dao that was attached to the death spirit dao, it cracked from a single bite.
“Ughhh. This stinks!”
The white dog spat. Why did this taste so terrible?
“Awooo! Awoooo!”
Whatever. He only needed to brush his teeth and rinse his mouth with the water from the River of Time later.
At first, West Heavenly King was only slightly wary. But at the first exchange, he groaned in pain. He instantly realized that he was in trouble.
Damn it!
Where did such a powerful dog come from?
He had never heard of this dog!
He didn’t even know there was such a dog on their side!
On the other hand, the old turtle’s dao body was wild with joy. He was aware of this dog’s existence.
Culture King’s dog had arrived!
“Die!”
The old turtle roared, “My main body is still alive. Some experts must have arrived to help. Hurry! Kill West Heavenly King and conquer the Death Realm!”

Three experts attacked West Heavenly King together. Meanwhile, the book spirit and tea plant did not join the battle against the heavenly king. Rather, they attacked the marquises. They must win quickly and return to water the flowers!

Conquering the Death Realm? That was none of their business. They only cared about one thing. Finish the fight as soon as possible. Those flowers were very weak. They would die if they weren’t watered for three days. That would drive Fat Ball crazy.
Massive explosions erupted everywhere.
West Heavenly King roared in desperation. Previously, he had attacked confidently, never doubting that he would lose. But suddenly, he was plunged into such a crisis.

Damn it! The dog was too powerful. He could feel that the dog was no weaker than him. Or to be precise, the dog was only a little bit weaker than him. Curse this! Where did such a powerful dog come from?

This time, it was North Heavenly King’s turn to move. But before he could move, South Heavenly King’s voice rang out, “What’s the rush? Continue observing the battle. Remember your words earlier. If you go…you might die today.”

South Heavenly King was very surprised as well. In truth, she could vaguely remember that this seemed to be…Culture King’s dog! To the north, North Heavenly King’s expression changed repeatedly. This dog had actually entered from the world of the living. What happened in the world of the living?
Would things grow even more troublesome for him in the Death Realm? Even now, things were already incredibly troublesome.
